title: Laughing Toddler Boy on Tricycle, House Yard - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An exuberant candid snapshot of a laughing toddler balanced precariously on the frame and pedals of a classic metal tricycle. He wears striped bib overalls over a Peter Pan collar shirt. In the background stands a white clapboard home with multi-pane sash windows and a small white garden picket fence, epitomizing mid-20th-century American childhood outdoors.
